sloka: गज सा गज नासोरुः यदि दृष्टा त्वया भवेत् ।ताम् मन्ये विदिताम् तुभ्यम् आख्याहि वर वारण ॥३-६०-२४॥
transliteration: gaja sā gaja nāsoruḥ yadi dṛṣṭā tvayā bhavet ।tām manye viditām tubhyam ākhyāhi vara vāraṇa ॥3-60-24॥

translations.english: O elephant tell me if you have seen her whose thighs are like the trunk of an elephant. O best of elephants, tell me if you know her.
